title: Lost Mary Nera15K Dubai Chocolate Prefilled Vape Pod
description: The Dubai Chocolate Lost Mary Nera15K Prefilled Pod offers a decadent twist with chocolate and pistachio notes. Smooth, sweet Cocoa forms the base, layered with the nutty richness of Pistachio for a flavour that’s indulgent yet well-balanced. A unique profile for those who enjoy dessert-inspired blends. Each pack includes one 2ml Prefilled Pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, plus a 15ml Refill Pod that automatically keeps the pod topped up. This system supports up to 15,000 puffs depending on use, with no messy refills or coil replacements. With a 0.6ohm mesh coil built in, the pod ensures consistent flavour and vapour output throughout. Made for the Lost Mary Nera30K Prefilled Pod Kit, installation is quick and clean: simply click the pod and refill pod into place and you’re ready to go. How to Use: 1. Remove all packaging and protective film. 2. Separate the 2ml prefilled pod and 10ml refill container. 3. Push the refill container into the pod until it clicks securely. 4. Attach the pod to your Nera30K device and remove the silicone plug from the mouthpiece. 5. Vape and enjoy. Once the e-liquid runs out, simply swap in a new Nera15K pod pack from a selection of 20 incredible Lost Mary flavour profiles.
